spec_match.rationale: Models Permissions Policy delegation through a three-level frame tree with the merged directive set, matching the delegation rules the merger relies on.

interactive.rationale: Three labelled selects re-render the frame tree; switching the top policy to 'none' changed the rendered outcomes in the driven session.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers allow-all, named-origin, self, and none states across three nesting levels including the blocked branch.

references.rationale: No chromestatus.com/feature/<id> link and no external spec link on the page — critical invariant 3 requires the self-heal link on every page.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 4 pass / 2 fail in this Chromium 141 session.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: changed topPolicy select, tree re-rendered (innerText delta observed); zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Only injected page-level telemetry.js; no per-demo assert telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Extensive CSS-variable usage, no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Selects carry aria-labels, but the re-rendered tree outcome is not announced via a live region.

openQuestions.title: Add the ChromeStatus reference link
openQuestions.detail: The page has no chromestatus.com/feature/6046077976444928 link (and no references section at all). Critical invariant 3 makes this link the slug-recovery self-heal; add a see-also block matching the sibling pages.

openQuestions.title: Announce inheritance results to assistive tech
openQuestions.detail: The frame-tree outcomes re-render silently on select change; an aria-live summary line ('grandchild: blocked — parent did not delegate') would make the simulation non-visually legible.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: changed the top-level policy select and watched the three-level frame tree re-render (allow→merge annotations, blocked branch visible), zero console errors; page lacks any ChromeStatus/spec reference links.
